# Mesh import fixtures

These are format conversions of TexUtil's original MIT-licensed preview torus.
FBX, GLB and glTF were exported with Blender in a factory-startup background
process, retaining static transforms, normals, the UV atlas and material slots.
The `.bin` belongs to `torus.gltf`. The no-UV OBJ removes only texture coordinates
from the original source. No third-party model assets are included.
